problem_statement: 26263: APAAR ID-Based Student Data Management and Verification Platform for AICTE-Approved Institutions

planted_cases_for_evaluation.title: 40 Students Sharing Single Phone Hash in Meerut
planted_cases_for_evaluation.institution_name: Institute of Technology & Advanced Management, Meerut
planted_cases_for_evaluation.how_to_verify: Navigate to 'Review Flags & Fraud Graph' tab, select ITAM Meerut from the dropdown, inspect the Red Cluster Node and click Cluster 1 in the side panel evidence drawer.

planted_cases_for_evaluation.title: Approved Intake Ceiling Breached in Pune
planted_cases_for_evaluation.institution_name: Apex Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences, Pune
planted_cases_for_evaluation.how_to_verify: Navigate to National Dashboard or Institution Dashboard for Apex Institute; observe 'Ceiling Exceeded' status and red intake utilisation indicator.

planted_cases_for_evaluation.title: Quota Admissions Missing from State Allotment List
planted_cases_for_evaluation.institution_name: Shri Ramswaroop Memorial Institute of Engineering, Lucknow
planted_cases_for_evaluation.how_to_verify: Navigate to 'Review Flags', select SRM Institute Lucknow, click 'State Allotment Reconciliation List' tab to view 12 unreconciled quota seats missing from merit counseling.

planted_cases_for_evaluation.title: Overlapping Active Enrolment in Two Institutions
planted_cases_for_evaluation.how_to_verify: Search for APAAR '887766554433' in 'Admission Records' or run Dry-Run validator with this APAAR ID to see concurrent active enrolment detection.

planted_cases_for_evaluation.title: Transliteration Variance vs Genuine Registry Mismatch
planted_cases_for_evaluation.institution_name: Vidyavardhini College of Engineering and Technology, Vasai

transliteration_case.outcome: Marked WARNING, routed to Discrepancy Queue for Nodal Officer verification.

planted_cases_for_evaluation.how_to_verify: Navigate to 'Discrepancy Queue' tab to view both records and execute nodal officer approval or rejection.

planted_cases_for_evaluation.title: 120 Records Stuck as Unconfirmed in Odisha
planted_cases_for_evaluation.institution_name: Kalinga Institute of Engineering and Technology, Bhubaneswar
planted_cases_for_evaluation.how_to_verify: Navigate to National Dashboard; Kalinga Institute displays an elevated unconfirmed rate (>38%) with statutory review advisory.
